text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After an outing with Ines Fujin, I<n>accompany her to
the amusement<n>park where she'll be working
today.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you're such a worrier! It's<n>still bright
out—you didn't have to<n>come all the way here with
me.
choice_data_list: Just think of it as the last stop of our trip.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Well, thanks! Okay, time to<n>scrub this place
clean!

text_block_list.name: Shift Supervisor
text_block_list.text: Oh, Ines! You're here early! What a<n>relief!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Heya-hey! What's got you in such a<n>hurry?

text_block_list.name: Shift Supervisor
text_block_list.text:
We're a little short-staffed today, so I<n>made some
last-minute changes to<n>people's posts. Ines, you'll
be on<n>haunted house duty!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: H-haunted house duty?!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin freezes up as a disturbed<n>expression
spreads across her face. I<n>vaguely recall that she's
not great<n>with scary stuff...
choice_data_list:
Are you going to be okay? Doesn't horror stuff
scare—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I-I'm just peachy! I can totally handlea haunted house!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Contrary to her claim, she looks<n>anything but
peachy. Unable to ignore<n>my concerns, I step in...
choice_data_list: Excuse me, but I happen to be her trainer...
Excuse me, but I happen to be her trainer...

text_block_list.name: Shift Supervisor
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Having changed into work attire, Ines<n>Fujin arrives
at the haunted house<n>looking disgruntled. The
reason<n>being...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ugh, you worry way too much! I knowmy supervisor's fine with it and all,but asking to observe me on the job?
choice_data_list: Sorry, but I'm just worried about you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Well, I guess four hands are better<n>than two.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
The haunted house is closed right<n>now because of
some machine<n>malfunctions. No one else has been
assigned here, so you're helping me<n>scrub this
place down!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Since you're here, I'll teach you the<n>art of cleaning!
First, you start with<n>the ceiling dust—

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Ka-thunk!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Eeek?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Wh-whoa, what gives? Oh, looks<n>like I got my foot
tangled in the<n>vacuum cable... Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Phew! I think that's most of it done.<n>I'm feeling
extra worn out today,<n>though—huh?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, someone's left their cleaning<n>cloth under the
sofa. Guess they<n>forget to put it away. ...Okay, got it.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Fwip...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Fwip...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Lying underneath the sofa, hidden out<n>of view, is a
mummy puppet. Its eyes<n>happen to meet Ines
Fujin's and—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Aaaargh?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Save me, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Good work today...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We somehow finish our cleaning<n>duties, but Ines
Fujin looks<n>completely exhausted. I feel like I
should break the silence...
choice_data_list:
It's okay to admit when you can't handle
something.

It's okay to admit when you can't handle
something.
It was interesting seeing you react like that.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We somehow finish our cleaning<n>duties, but Ines
Fujin looks<n>completely exhausted. I feel like I
should break the silence...
choice_data_list:
It's okay to admit when you can't handle
something.

It's okay to admit when you can't handle
something.
It was interesting seeing you react like that.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, maybe I was being a little<n>stubborn...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Truth is, my supervisor's kind<n>enough to adjust
my shifts when I<n>have training.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's why I was hoping to return the<n>favor
somehow...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But if you hadn't been there, Trainer,<n>I probably
would've only caused my<n>supervisor a headache.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, you're right! I should ask for<n>help when I
need it. Okay, I'll show<n>my gratitude with...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: A good race! I think that suits me<n>best!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I come away impressed by Ines<n>Fujin's strong
sense of duty—and by<n>the way she somehow
utilized<n>today's events to fuel her passion<n>for
racing!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you thought that was entertaining,<n>huh?! Hey
now, it's not nice to tease<n>people!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I made a real spectacle ofmyself today, huh? I was so lame!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, could you keep what<n>happened today
between us? I'm<n>really embarrassed about it...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that no matter how lame she<n>might have
seemed today, I won't tell<n>a soul about it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. You sure you can keep it<n>secret? You might
never see me<n>mess up this bad again, you know?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...But thanks!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin smiles softly. It looks like<n>this
experience has brought us even<n>closer together!
